Name: Apache Druid Arbitrary File Read
Description: Since there are no restrictions on the user-specified HTTP InputSource, application-level restrictions can be bypassed by passing a file URL to the HTTP InputSource. Because Apache Druid lacks authorization by default, an attacker can exploit this vulnerability to construct a malicious request to perform file reads without authorization, ultimately leading to the disclosure of sensitive server information.
